title: Compliance and Documentation Lead
salary: $165K – $223.3K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • Multiple Ranges
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Deepgram is looking for a Compliance and Documentation Lead to own the written and evidentiary backbone of our compliance program - privacy and security both - and the documents that auditors, enterprise customers, and our own engineers rely on to know what we actually do.

This is one seat covering both halves deliberately. You will own our privacy program's operational work - assessments, data flow maps, deletion and rights workflows, subprocessor reviews - and our security compliance obligations under SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS, along with the security questionnaires, policies, and public posture documents that sit on top of them. The reason to combine them is leverage: the same underlying facts about how Deepgram handles data answer a DPIA, a SOC 2 control, and a Fortune 500 questionnaire. Establishing them once and reusing them is the job.

Context matters here, because the claims you will be writing are unusually specific. Deepgram processes audio - often some of the most sensitive data our customers hold - across several deployment models: hosted with model-improvement opted in, hosted with model-improvement opted out (effectively zero data retention), single-tenant Deepgram Dedicated deployments with regional data residency, and fully self-hosted deployments running in the customer's own environment. Getting a statement right means knowing which of those it applies to.

Writing is the core skill in this role, and we mean writing that survives a skeptical reader - an auditor, an enterprise security reviewer, a customer DPO, an engineer who knows the system better than you do. Where a claim needs technical verification, you define what has to be proven and partner with Security Engineering to prove it; you are not expected to do that engineering work yourself.

This role reports to the Director of Information Security and works closely with Security Engineering, Legal, Research, and Solutions/Sales Engineering.

We are open on level. This is a senior individual-contributor role, and we will calibrate title, scope, and compensation to demonstrated experience.

ABOUT DEEPGRAM

You will lead senior data engineers, guide VA leaders through architecture decisions, and help build the platform's future on Azure Commercial with Databricks and Unity Catalog.
We're looking for an engineer first: someone who built pipelines and warehouses hands-on, then grew into leading teams and advising customers. You'll join a friendly, collaborative team doing work that makes a real difference for Veterans and their families.

• Set architecture and standards for ingestion, storage, modeling, and serving with Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Delta Lake.

title: Security Audit & Controls, Security GRC
locationText: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the team

Anthropic's Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team is the connective tissue that holds the company accountable to its security commitments. We translate regulatory, customer, and voluntary obligations into controls that teams act on, and give leadership a bird's-eye view of how well we're meeting them. We're building toward a fundamentally different kind of GRC: one that directs Claude, with the right humans in the loop, to challenge and evidence the performance of controls continuously rather than through periodic audits.

Within Security GRC, Compliance & Audit Programs run the integrated audit across our frameworks and maintains the Common Control Framework, the single set of controls that the whole program is built on. This role sits in Audit & Assurance and owns the framework and the assurance view across every control domain.

About the role

As part of the Security Audit & Controls team,  you will own the CCF across every control domain, from access and change management to logging, encryption, and people controls: which controls we have, what each one says, how each maps to the frameworks and commitments we hold, and whether each one is actually working. You'll work with control owners and GRC Partners to draft and validate control descriptions and activities that describe reality rather than policy intent, build the monitoring that shows operating effectiveness continuously instead of once a year, and drive what monitoring finds to closure with control owners.

Own the Common Control Framework: the canonical control set, its mappings to SOC 2, ISO 27001/42001, HIPAA, FedRAMP, and customer commitments, and the change process for adding, retiring, or rewording controls

Draft and validate control descriptions and control activities with control owners, so each control states who does what, how often, in which system, and what evidence proves it

•

title: Data Engineering Senior Manager
Technical Lead Manager, Synthetic Data
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Simulation Teams

Simulation is advancing our end-to-end autonomous driving research. The team’s mission is to accelerate our journey to AV2.0 by incubating capabilities that become company-level advantages. GAIA, our generative world models, and the synthetic data they produce, are one of those. This role leads Synthetic Data within Simulation. The team exists to dramatically reduce our dependency on expensive and time-consuming on-road data collection by turning generative world models (models like GAIA-3) into a production engine for training-grade experience. When we can restage real driving onto a camera rig that does not exist yet, rewrite ego motion to create scenarios we have never encountered, and land that data in the same training stack we use for real driving, we can train, evaluate and deploy on vehicles and in geographies we have barely collected from. As Tech Lead Manager, you’ll lead a high-performing team of machine learning engineers and help us answer questions like: can we train and validate a driving model for a vehicle platform before the fleet exists, can synthetically generated data replace scarce real-world data for training and evaluation, and how quickly can we deploy autonomous driving in a geography where we’ve never collected AV data?

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Algorithmic and system design: define approach to GAIA generation, system design of the synthetic data pipeline and controllability engine, focus on efficiency and quality.

- Cross-team collaboration: aligning with driving-model owners and with evaluation and safety team on utility and scalability of generated data.

- Mentorship / async review: reviewing a teammate’s experimental design, PR, or ablation write-up and giving direct feedback.

- 1:1s and feedback: building rapport and managing your direct reports.

- Up to date with state of the art: keeping current on video generation, camera transfer, distillation - insofar as it changes a checkpoint or a mix we ship.

- Strategy: leading or joining strategic discussions on the synthetic data roadmap, safety case and platform bring-up sequencing.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Architect the future - set the technical direction for how we post-train and condition world models for synthetic-data capabilities (rig transfer, pose transfer, controllability), holding a high bar for what counts as training-grade generation.

- Own the loop end to end - make sure generation, evaluation and training stay one system: from checkpoint and config, through large-scale GPU inference, to artefacts that land in driving-model training with reproducible lineage.

- Get hands-on when it matters - lead from the front on key components, codebases and experiments.

- Push throughput and yield - drive inference optimisation (distillation, few-step sampling, KV caching, step count), valid-generation rate, and self-serve workflows so model developers can request synthetic sets without a specialist in the loop.

title: Support Engineer
description:
About Us:
Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.

Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.
 

About the Role
Spreedly is looking for a Support Engineer to take on our most complex customer issues and bridge the gap between support and engineering. You'll go beyond identifying a bug: you'll investigate where it occurs, explain its impact, and give engineering the evidence and technical context needed to resolve it.
You'll join an international support team that serves customers, partners, prospects, and internal colleagues. Our Tier 1 team provides round-the-clock support, while Tier 2 handles deeper technical investigations. This role brings additional engineering depth to that work, particularly in troubleshooting SDKs and complex payments integrations.
This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll work directly on difficult cases while helping teammates develop their technical skills. We also want this hire to help lay the foundation for a potential Tier 3 support function. That expansion and any future team leadership role are subject to leadership approval, rather than guaranteed next steps.
We expect roughly 60% of your time to focus on complex customer tickets, most of them from our top-tier accounts. The remaining time will involve retrospectives, customer advocacy, cross-functional projects, and coaching.

Spreedly Product Offering:
Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:
Connect - A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault - A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.

title: Data Engineer, Data Quality & Provenance
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Data Quality & Provenance Team

Our Data Quality & Provenance team sits within Wayve’s AI Platform organisation and builds the trusted data foundations behind our self-driving technology. We transform vast volumes of fleet and simulation data into discoverable, reliable and reproducible datasets for model training, evaluation, replay, scenario mining and safety analysis. Operating at petabyte scale, the team defines the data products, standards and systems that enable our engineering teams to use data with confidence.

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Design and operate scalable batch and streaming pipelines for multimodal fleet and simulation data.

- Build data models, catalogues, indexes and query capabilities that make sensor, vehicle-state, map and event data easy to discover and use.

- Create versioned, reproducible datasets for training, evaluation, replay, scenario mining and safety analysis.

- Develop workflows for data ingestion, synchronisation, transformation, curation, labelling and quality validation.

- Partner with autonomy, ML, simulation and safety engineers to define schemas, APIs and data contracts.

- Improve the reliability, performance and cost efficiency of large-scale storage and compute workloads.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

- Petabyte-scale data products supporting autonomous-driving development across ML, autonomy, simulation and safety teams.

- Trusted datasets with strong versioning, lineage and reproducibility guarantees.

- Metadata, geospatial and temporal indexing that enables data discovery, selection and scenario mining.

- Systems that combine real-world fleet logs with simulation and synthetic data for closed-loop development.

- Data-quality standards, observability, access controls, retention policies and incident-response processes.

- Cloud-based storage and distributed-compute infrastructure designed for reliability, scalability and cost efficiency.

🙌 You should apply if

- You have strong hands-on Python and SQL skills, supported by solid production software-engineering fundamentals.

- You have designed and operated large-scale distributed data systems beyond small analytics or reporting pipelines.

- You have production experience with distributed-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies such as Spark, Flyte or Airflow.

- You have built cloud-based data platforms using object storage and understand data organisation, versioning, querying, governance and cost management.

- You have owned data quality, lineage, observability, reproducibility and incident response for production data workflows.

- You can translate ambiguous requirements from ML, data-science, robotics or similarly technical teams into durable, reusable platform capabilities.

- You are comfortable working in ambiguity and helping define the standards and operating model for a growing data platform.

- Experience with autonomous vehicles, ADAS, robotics, mapping, sensor-rich systems, geospatial data or multimodal datasets would be an advantage.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments

title: Sleep Consultant (Part-Time)
description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity
As a Sleep Consultant, you are the voice of Hatch ’s sleep support. You will connect with caregivers through sleep chat in the Hatch Baby app, offering warm, personalized guidance that helps them understand their child’s sleep, choose realistic next steps, and feel supported along the way. You balance developmental accuracy with genuine care, and you are passionate about helping others and meeting every caregiver with empathy, especially during some of the most tiring moments of parenthood. We are hiring for multiple part-time positions, 20 hours per week on set shifts, M-F 7am-11am PT or M-F 11am-3pm PT. These are hourly, part-time roles.
What You’ll Do
Provide expert, personalized sleep guidance

• Apply your knowledge of infant and child sleep development to give accurate, age-appropriate guidance aligned with Hatch ’s approved approaches and resources.

• Follow safe sleep guidelines and Hatch sleep training guidelines at all times.

• Ask purposeful questions to understand each family’s challenges, routines, goals, and circumstances, and adjust your recommendations as new information emerges.

• Help families put recommendations into practice, set realistic expectations, and troubleshoot obstacles.

• Guide caregivers to relevant Hatch Baby sleep features and content, and explain how they support their goals.

• Recognize when a concern is outside the scope of sleep support, including medical questions, feeding, and urgent situations, and refer families to their pediatrician or escalate through the appropriate channel

Communicate clearly and with empathy

• Write warm, concise responses suited to a chat conversation, leading with actionable next steps and explaining your reasoning.

• Respond to caregiver stress with validation, patience, and respect.

• Build confidence without judgment, pressure, or promises of specific sleep outcomes.

• Review all conversation history and context before responding.

• Document key details, recommendations, and next steps so another consultant can pick up the conversation seamlessly.

• Follow shared Hatch standards, and address differing recommendations thoughtfully to maintain trust.

• Manage your conversations efficiently while maintaining quality, and meet established response time and customer satisfaction expectations

Who You Are

•
Passionate about helping others. You care about caregivers and love helping a family feel confident and rested.

•
Empathetic. You build trust without judgment, even when a family is stressed or exhausted.

•
A strong writer. You communicate clearly, warmly, and concisely in writing.

•
Detail-oriented. You keep accurate documentation and notice the details that matter in each family’s story.

•
Experienced with sleep. You have experience with infant and child sleep develop

Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o  maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina . Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram , criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões .

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

 

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

• Nosso time  atua no modelo híbrido , unindo a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto com a troca do presencial no nosso escritório 1 vez por semana.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

 

O Manager de Segmentação traduz a carteira de Cobrança e Despejo em personas de clientes bem definidas - grupos caracterizados por diferentes perfis, motivações e comportamentos de pagamento - e estabelece, em nível macro, a estratégia de tratamento que cada persona exige.

A atuação dessa posição vai muito além da modelagem estatística. Esta pessoa é responsável por responder por que um determinado grupo deve ser tratado de forma diferente de outro, qual hipótese comportamental sustenta essa diferenciação e qual abordagem maximiza a recuperação financeira e a experiência do cliente para cada perfil. O principal entregável é uma tese estratégica defensável por persona , que servirá como pilar fundamental para a execução das frentes de Políticas, Jornada e Operações.

O papel combina raciocínio estruturado e profundidade analítica: diagnosticar padrões ao longo da carteira, formular hipóteses sobre seus motivadores e convertê-los em direcionamento estratégico de alto impacto diante da liderança sênior.

 

Suas Responsabilidades

 

1. Definir as personas de clientes da carteira

•
Construir e evoluir a segmentação que traduz o portfólio em personas , considerando perfil de risco, comportamento de pagamento, contexto da inadimplência, relacionamento com o produto e potencial de valor.

•
Caracterizar cada persona de forma acionável: o que define o grupo, como ele se comporta, o que motiva a resolução do débito e onde está sua principal barreira para pagamento.

•
Definir critérios de classificação e reclassificação que regem a migração dos clientes entre personas ao longo do ciclo de vida de cobrança.

2. Liderar a macroestratégia de tratamento por persona

•

Job Title:
Clinical Research Coordinator - Comprehensive Cancer Center Department:
CCC | Sponsored Research Position Summary
The Clinical Research Coordinator serves as a key member of a multidisciplinary research team supporting federally funded and foundation-funded research projects focused on cancer prevention, cancer control, health disparities, survivorship, and other health-related outcomes in rural and medically underserved communities throughout Ohio. This position is responsible for coordinating and implementing complex clinical and community-based research studies, with a particular emphasis on engaging participants in rural and Appalachian regions.

The Clinical Research Coordinator independently manages day-to-day research operations, facilitates participant recruitment and retention, maintains regulatory compliance, coordinates community partnerships, and ensures timely completion of study milestones. The position requires frequent interaction with study participants, healthcare providers, community organizations, and external collaborators across Ohio. Regular travel throughout rural Ohio is required.

Responsibilities

• Coordinates multiple clinical, population-based, and community-engaged research studies.

• Implements study protocols and standard operating procedures in accordance with sponsor, institutional, and regulatory requirements.

• Oversees participant recruitment, enrollment, informed consent, data collection, and follow-up activities.

• Schedules and conducts study visits in clinical, community, and virtual settings.

• Maintains study databases and participant tracking systems.

• Assists investigators with study startup, activation, and closeout activities.

• Monitors study progress and ensures adherence to project timelines and deliverables.

• Serves as a primary liaison between research teams and community partners across rural Ohio.

• Builds and maintains relationships with healthcare organizations, community health centers, faith-based organizations, local health departments, and other stakeholders.

• Coordinates outreach events, educational programs, health fairs, screening initiatives, and community meetings.

• Assists with development and implementation of culturally appropriate recruitment and retention strategies.

• Supports Community Advisory Boards and stakeholder engagement activities.

• Facilitates participant navigation and addresses barriers to study participation.

• Prepares and submits Institutional Review Board (IRB) applications, amendments, continuing reviews, and reportable events.

• Maintains regulatory binders and study documentation.

• Ensures compliance with federal regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), HIPAA, and university policies.

• Participates in study monitoring visits, audits, and sponsor reviews.

• Tracks protocol deviations and assists with corrective action plans when necessary.

• Collects, enters, verifies, and manages research data using electronic data capture systems.

• Performs quality assurance and quality control

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

title: Head of Science, Permanent Magnets
description:
ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. The company emerged from Alphabet Inc. as an independent, growth capital-backed company in 2022, funded by leading investors and supported by a braintrust of industry leaders.

At SandboxAQ, we’ve cultivated an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and impact. By investing deeply in our people, we’re building a thriving, global workforce poised to tackle the world's epic challenges. Join us to advance your career in pursuit of an inspiring mission, in a community of like-minded people who value entrepreneurialism, ownership, and transformative impact.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team: The Magnets team is one of several key research verticals within SandboxAQ’s broader Chemical Simulation group, which uses advanced computational methods, physics-based simulation, and AI to discover and develop novel materials. This group is focused on solving critical materials challenges that matter to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing and industrial resilience.

Within that larger effort, this group is focused on one of the most strategically important materials problems: developing high-performance permanent magnets that reduce or eliminate reliance on neodymium and other rare earth elements and can be produced in the United States. The goal is to create novel magnet formulations that can be manufactured using existing industry processes and equipment, while matching or exceeding the performance of today’s leading NdFeB magnets in demanding applications such as semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, precision motion devices, and defense technologies.

Introduction to the role: We are looking for a Head of Science to lead the scientific direction of the Magnets vertical. This person will define the research strategy and technical roadmap, build and lead a top-tier scientific team, and help shape how computational materials discovery, simulation, and AI are applied to accelerate magnet development.

This leader will work at the intersection of domain science and platform innovation. You will help shape the magnetism-aware LQM and multi-scale modeling strategy in close partnership with our AI simulation platform teams, while also guiding dataset strategy, modeling priorities, and experimental validation to turn cutting-edge research into practical, manufacturable magnet technologies.

You will also serve as a key external scientific representative for the program, working with national labs, manufacturing partners, defense organizations, and equipment companies.

See how SandboxAQ is helping build America's semiconductor supply chain from the materials up. https://www.sandboxaq.com/post/sandboxaq-helping-build-americas-semiconductor-supply-chain

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the scientific charter and technical roadmap for the Magnets vertical, including phase stability, magnetocrystalline anisotropy, finite-temperature coercivity, and microstructure engineering across Fe- and Co-based intermetallic systems with U.S.-accessible alloying elements.

- IP Engine Management: Oversee the translation of generative design outputs into a robust IP portfolio, ensuring the team owns the most valuable "white space" in substrate chemistry and structural design.

- Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of research scientists, computational/ML scientists, and postdocs; set the scientific bar, run technical reviews, and develop talent toward NewCo readiness.

- Specify and prioritize the magnetism-aware LQM, datageneration, and multi-scale modeling capabilities required from the AISim plat

title: Care Manager

The ideal candidate will have strong time management and assessment skills, telephonic experience, excellent communication and customer service skills, behavioral health knowledge, strong organizational skills, and be comfortable working with computers.

• May perform telephonic, digital, home and/or other site visits outreach to assess member needs and collaborate with resources

• Coordinates as appropriate between the member and/or family/caregivers, community resources, and the care provider team to ensure identified services are accessible to members

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca 's rapid growth. If you align with our core values-Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable-and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role
As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca 's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. Platform also owns Authentication, Developer Experience and QA, and AI-Native Engineering. Streaming is roughly two-thirds of the job and where we expect you to become the deepest engineer in the company; across the other three you review the designs, hold an informed opinion, and lead the work where they meet streaming.
This is a Staff role, so we are hiring for direction as much as delivery - the engineer who decides what the streaming platform looks like in two years, writes the RFC that gets three teams to agree, and then builds the hard part. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. Most of our time goes into Go, but we also write Helm charts, dig through logs and metrics, and get pulled into a wide variety of problems.
Things You Get To Do

• Own the architecture of our event streaming platform end to end - Redpanda, the UTS ecosystem, client libraries and user-facing streaming - and set its two-to-three-year direction

• Lead the shift from batch to event-driven across Alpaca 's systems, working with the teams who own them rather than around them

• Design user-facing streaming at scale: connection fan-out, slow consumers, backpressure, ordering and delivery guarantees, and the failure modes that only show up on a volatile market day

• Set the standards for event-driven design - schema evolution, topic ownership, replay, idempotency - and own the shared libraries other teams build against, including the cost of versioning and deprecation

• Shape AuthN/AuthZ direction across Alpaca and lead the work where identity meets streaming: authorizing real-time subscriptions, token lifecycle on long-lived connections, multi-tenant isolation

• Help shape how Alpaca builds with AI - the schemas, contracts and event streams you own are the substrate our agentic development platform runs on

• Partner with SRE on chaos testing and game days for the event backbone, and with our QA stream on test tooling and pre-production gates, so resilience is verified rather than assumed

• Lead through influence rather than authority, and mu

title: People Operations Manager
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN US

- Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

- Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

- Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

YOUR IMPACT

As a People Operations Specialist, you'll help build the operational foundation that enables our teams to thrive as we grow internationally. Your work will ensure our people processes are efficient, scalable, and employee-centric.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Coordinate day-to-day people operations so everything runs smoothly across regions.

- Manage the administration of key employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, etc.) and keep improving how they work.

- Spot inefficiencies and suggest practical improvements that align with business priorities.

- Use tools and systems to simplify people processes and make them more scalable.

- Work closely with teams across the business to drive projects from start to finish.

- Maintain clear SOPs and policies so people processes are consistent across locations.

- Resolve day-to-day people queries around people topics

- Partner effectively with external providers (payroll, benefits, etc.) to ensure smooth and reliable service delivery.

- Track compliance and manage risks across the regions you support.

WHO YOU ARE

- Leading with empathy and sensitivity

- Advanced knowledge of HRIS systems, particularly HiBob

- Ability to handle complex projects, strong analytical skills, and attention to detail

- Familiarity with AI-driven workflows and continuous improvement methodologies

- Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information in a professional manner

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

title: Conversion Optimization Manager, Growth (Fixed Term Contract)
description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

As a Conversion Optimization Manager, Growth, you’ll own the conversion rate optimization strategy for Lightspeed’s marketing websites, treating our digital experience as a product. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities, develop and test hypotheses, and implement data-driven improvements that enhance the user experience and drive conversion across the customer journey.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Growth Marketing, the ideal candidate is a self-starter who thinks strategically and is proactive in delivering performance insights.

Location: Lightspeed is seeking candidates based in the Montreal, Quebec, or Toronto, Ontario regions. This role follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation to work from the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

What you’ll be doing:

- Own, develop, and execute a testing strategy to improve website conversion rates.

- Analyze website performance to identify variables that influence conversion and prioritize opportunities with the greatest potential impact.

- Manage the testing backlog and coordinate tasks across design, development, and content teams to support the execution of experiments.

- Proactively build relationships and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define and drive the A/B testing roadmap.

- Partner with data analysts to identify meaningful performance metrics, measure experiment outcomes, and develop user-friendly reports.

- Serve as the subject matter expert on website user behavior, helping stakeholders understand and accurately interpret experiment results.

What you need to bring:

- A proven track record of owning and executing website conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives.

- Hands-on experience with A/B testing and experimentation tools, with a strong preference for Wingify (VWO); experience with Optimizely is an asset.

- A strong understanding of CRO fundamentals, statistics, and probability.

- Advanced proficiency in GA4, Looker, and Looker Studio, with the ability to independently build and interpret standard reports.

- Strong project management and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate cross-functional initiatives.

- Experience designing and running website experiments on high-traffic domains.

- The ability to clearly communicate experiment objectives, insights, and results to non-technical audiences.

- Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to influence stakeholders and drive alignment across teams.

- As a global company with employees and clients outside of Quebec, fluency in English as a working language is required for this position.

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

- Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Lead QA Engineer, AI Automation
description:
We take play seriously. We’re looking for curious adventurers ready to find their party, fueled by imagination and drive to build what’s never been built before. At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. This is your chance to shape legendary play that lasts a lifetime.

QMO is responsible for the quality benchmark that every Hasbro project adheres to - covering requirements through closure - across AI, automation, manual, performance, security, and compatibility testing. The team is transitioning from manual and legacy scripted automation to AI-enhanced testing, involving a move to Playwright and embracing Tosca's agentic AI features.

We're hiring a Lead QA Engineer to lead our transition to AI-enhanced test automation. This is a technical leadership role without formal direct reports. You will develop the automation strategy and directly guide the daily automation and AI efforts of our offshore vendor team. You will advise the technical aspects of our Selenium-to-Playwright migration, the integration of Tosca's AI/agentic features, and test coverage across SAP, P2M, and Hasbro CLM(which is migrating to AWS). We seek someone highly skilled to help build the future of our QA processes!

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and lead the technical strategy for AI-enhanced test automation. This reduces dependence on manually written scripts by adopting AI and agentic automation methods, such as Tosca's agentic AI capabilities.

• Lead the migration of automation suites from Selenium to Playwright, including framework architecture and standard methodologies.

• Manage the daily automation and AI-related activities of our offshore vendor team, determining priorities and evaluating output quality - without formal people-management responsibility.

• Take ownership for test case management and regression/defect tracking methods in qTest, ensuring they grow alongside the team's automation-first approach.

• Collaborate with SAP and P2M functional teams to integrate automation coverage into their release cycles.

• Support QA needs for Hasbro CLM through its migration to AWS, including planning test coverage on the new platform.

• Translate business and QA strategy into concrete implementation plans - proactively identifying risk and next steps rather than completing a fixed task list.

• Provide updates on automation progress, potential risks, and suggestions to QA leadership.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of QA automation experience, including demonstrated lead-level ownership of automation strategy.

• Practical experience with Tricentis Tosca, including building, structuring and maintaining automation scripts

• Solid practical experience with Playwright, including firsthand involvement in transitioning automation suites from Selenium.

• Demonstrated experience applying AI-augmented automation approaches to reduce manual script authoring - not just traditional record-and-playback or hand-coded scripting.

• Experience with qTest for managing test cases and tracking regression/defects.

• Testing background across SAP and P2M platforms.

• Practical understanding of or direct experience with AWS services.

• Experience directing or closely coordinating the work of an offshore vendor QA/automation team.

• Proven capability to convert business and test strategy into a detailed action plan, instead of merely finishing assigned tasks - showing solid responsibility and discernment.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

• Experience with NeoLoad or a comparable performance testing tool.

• Familiarity with Azure (SharePoint Framework, Azure Functions) - Hasbro CLM's current platform ahead of its AWS migration.

• Exposure to RMS and CSP platforms.

• CI/CD pipeline experience (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).

• Scripting/programming proficiency

In this role, you will bridge Product, Sales, and Go-To-Market by translating complex technical capabilities into clear customer value, shaping product roadmaps based on real engineering workflows, and proving PVcase 's unique advantage to the market. Deep solar industry and technical expertise are required, while formal product marketing experience is secondary.

• Own positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, and adoption initiatives for PVcase Ground Mount, Roof Mount, and Yield.

• Develop a deep understanding of utility-scale solar engineering workflows, customer needs, and technical pain points.

• Partner closely with Product Management to bring customer, market, engineering, and competitive insights into roadmap decisions.

• Translate complex technical capabilities into clear customer value and differentiated product narratives.

• Lead technical go-to-market planning for new products, features, and workflows.

• Own demo strategy and help create credible, real-world solar engineering use cases.

• Support Sales and Solutions teams on strategic opportunities requiring deeper product or industry expertise.

• Develop technical sales enablement, training, presentations, webinars, and educational content.

• Serve as a bridge between Product, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and technical customers.

• Help commercial teams understand not only what PVcase does, but how and why solar professionals use it.

Requirements

• 3+ years of professional experience in the solar industry, ideally within utility-scale solar.

• Strong understanding of solar project development, design, engineering, or construction workflows.

• Hands-on experience with AutoCAD or other CAD-based design and engineering software.

• Experience in solar engineering, PV design, applications engineering, solutions engineering, project engineering, EPC, development, or a similar technical role.

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Renewable Energy, or another relevant technical discipline preferred, or equivalent industry experience.

• Strong understanding of how developers, EPCs, engineering firms, and technical teams work and make decisions.

• Ability to quickly learn and confidently demonstrate technical software and workflows.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex engineering concepts.

• Comfortable presenting to technical customers, commercial teams, and senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical skills and ability to translate customer, market, and competitive insights into recommendations.

• Commercial mindset with the ability to connect technical capabilities to customer and business value.

• Proactive, self-directed, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

• Fluent or bilingual-level English.

PVcase is moving solar forward with an alternative to the traditional labor-intensive, time-consuming, error-prone solar project development process. title: Technical Partnerships Manager
description:
About Apaleo

Apaleo is the world’s most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Every great integration starts with a conversation. As a Technical Partnerships Manager, you are the person partners talk to when they want to build on Apaleo. You will help partners, from early-stage startups to large corporates, build integrations that work well for hotels. You will explain our APIs, review how partners have built their use case and show them what good looks like. You will work with CTOs, product managers and developers, switching context quickly and enjoying the technical detail. This is a technical, partner-facing role, not a commercial one.

What you’ll do

• Onboard new integration partners and guide them from first contact to go-live

• Explain how Apaleo works and how partners can best use our APIs for their use case

• Certify apps for the Apaleo Store, review how they are built and recommend improvements

• Help partners improve both the business and technical logic of their integrations

• Monitor partner API performance, using tools like Datadog, and spot issues before they become problems

• Resolve support tickets from partners, and escalations from customers about integrations

• Tell partners when our API changes and help them adapt

• Write and update our developer documentation, including guides that show what a good integration looks like

• Reach out to potential partners where demand exists, for example French partners as our sales team expands into France

• Share technical requirements and business opportunities from partner work with product, marketing, business development and customer success

What you’ll bring

Essential

• Experience in hospitality or travel tech, in any role from customer success to revenue management or reservations.

• Understanding of the hotel tech ecosystem: PMS, channel managers, booking engines, payments and distribution, and how data flows between them

• A clear grasp of what an API is, and the confidence to join technical conversations with developers. “I don’t know, let me find out” is the right attitude

• Technical curiosity. You don’t need to write code, but you enjoy digging into why something broke

• The ability to explain technical topics to non-technical people, and commercial topics to engineers

• Experience managing technology partners or similar external stakeholders

• A proactive mindset, and the ability to switch context quickly

Nice to have

• Basic knowledge of REST, OAuth and webhooks

• Experience with log management or monitoring tools such as Datadog

• Experience with a marketplace or app store programme

• Experience with certification or QA processes for integrations

• German or French

Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.

You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. • Support administration and troubleshooting of relational database platforms used within the enterprise environment.

description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

The Strategy & Business Operations team’s mission is to support decision making on critical C-level topics and act as a force-multiplier for functional priorities across the organization. We are looking for a BizOps Lead to join the team, reporting to the Head of BizOps, focused on strategy, corporate development, and cross-functional projects.

In this intermediate level individual contributor role, you may:

- Influence strategic decision-making by collaborating with and building consensus among leaders across the organization, including product, GTM, and research and engineering

- Optimize pricing and packaging, ensuring that the company's offerings are both attractive to customers and profitable

- Build financial models and analyses to evaluate new and existing opportunities

- Contribute to corporate development activities: fundraising, strategic partnerships, investor relations, M&A, etc.

- Conduct market and competitive analysis to anticipate and respond to emerging trends and to identify new opportunities for innovation and growth

This role is a good match if you:

- Have 3-4 years of top tier investment banking / investing experience, ideally with a focus on software, technology, or digital infrastructure

- OR Have 2-3 years of top tier consulting experience, ideally with a focus on software / technology; further experience in BizOps, product, or investing is also valued

- Have some technical background (e.g., CS, EE, Applied Math, or related undergraduate degree, software engineering internships)

- Are a clear communicator with a high-ownership mentality and bias to action

- Are a problem solver: can operate at a level 4-5 on this hierarchy https://medium.com/helpful-com/how-to-be-an-effective-early-stage-employee-hint-be-helpful-e681b456a01f

FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

- A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

- Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

- RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

- 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

- Annual enrichment benefits:

Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

- 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

- Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

- Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

- For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

- For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

- Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

title: Associate Director, Amazon Advertising
description:
This opportunity is ideal for a senior Amazon advertising professional with strong campaign management, analytical, client-facing, and leadership experience.
What You'll Do:

• Oversee the end-to-end execution of Amazon advertising campaigns, including planning, budgeting, targeting, and optimization.

• Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to ensure seamless campaign execution and delivery.

• Monitor and analyze Amazon advertising campaign performance and provide actionable insights and recommendations.

• Help develop and improve Amazon advertising best practices, processes, and the overall practice roadmap.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and key stakeholders.

• Develop and promote innovative campaign concepts using a test-and-learn approach.

• Lead and mentor team members, helping grow Amazon advertising knowledge and capabilities across the practice.

• Help shape and communicate the organization's Retail Media offering to internal teams, current clients, and prospective clients.

• Actively manage delivery team workloads to maximize output while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.

• 4+ years of professional experience in Amazon advertising.

• Strong knowledge of Amazon advertising and campaign management.

• Demonstrable success delivering Amazon Sponsored Ads campaigns.

• Excellent presentation, data analysis, and reporting skills.

• Strong client relationship and communication skills.

• Strong attention to detail with a methodical and process-oriented approach.

• Confident, dynamic, engaging, and authentic communication style.

• Passion for continuous learning and helping others develop their knowledge and capabilities.

Nice to Haves:

• Experience with Amazon DSP .

• Experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) .

• Experience developing Amazon advertising best practices or processes.

• Experience leading or mentoring other advertising professionals.

• Experience working with Retail Media strategies and client-facing projects.

•
Project Type: Ongoing project

•
Engagement: Hourly contract

•
Expected Workload: Less than 30 hours per week

•
Initial Duration: 1-3 months

•
Seniority: Expert

•
Location: UK or Europe, within approximately ±2 hours of the UK time zone

•
Availability: Monday-Friday, 1:00 AM-6:00 AM UK time

• Higher rates may be considered for highly experienced professionals.

An enterprise client is seeking an experienced Associate Director, Amazon Advertising to help shape and oversee Amazon advertising strategies and delivery for clients. This role will help define campaign objectives, measure performance and impact, and ensure advertising programs align with broader client goals and KPIs.
The selected consultant will also help develop innovative ideas through a test-and-learn approach, contribute to Amazon advertising best practices, and share successful strategies across the practice. This is a great opportunity for an experienced Amazon advertising professional who enjoys working with clients, leading delivery teams, and helping grow knowledge and capabilities across the practice.
